definitions.gloss: kneecap; the front of the knee
definitions.explanation: The rounded front of the knee.

examples.japanese: {膝頭|ひざがしら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ぶつけた→ぶつける：02413_butsukeru⟧。

examples.english: There's a cut on my knee.

examples.japanese: ⟦{机|つくえ}→机：00762_tsukue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{膝頭|ひざがしら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}って→打つ：01221_utsu⟧、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦{歩|ある}けなかった→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I hit my knee on the corner of the desk and couldn't walk for a while.

notes:
A slightly more precise word than ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧ for the front of the knee. In anatomy the kneecap bone is {膝蓋骨|しつがいこつ}, also called ⟦{膝|ひざ}→膝：00940_hiza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皿|さら}→皿：00883_sara⟧.

- {膝頭|ひざがしら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ぶつける→ぶつける：02413_butsukeru⟧: to bang one's knee
- {膝頭|ひざがしら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擦|す}りむく: to scrape one's knee
